name: sprocket_520_45t
description: Aluminium 7075-T6 rear sprocket for a 520 chain — radial tooth repetition, PCD mounting circle and lightweight cutouts.

stages.prompt:
Aluminium rear sprocket (7075-T6) for a 520 motorcycle chain, fully parametric.

Frame: the flat sprocket disc lies on the XY plane (bottom face at z = 0), centred on the origin in X and Y. Thickness 6 mm in Z. mm units.

Chain data (520): pitch p = 15.875 mm, roller diameter 10.16 mm. Teeth: N = 45 evenly spaced, pitch circle PCD = p / sin(180/N) = 227.6 mm.

Build it feature by feature:
- Web disc: solid disc radius r = 0..108, 6 mm thick.
- Tooth ring on the rim: 45 identical trapezoidal teeth, angular pitch 8 degrees. Each seat is a concave roller seat of radius 5.4 mm centred on the PCD (r = 113.8); tooth tips rise ~5 mm above the PCD so the outer diameter lands at ~236 mm; the gap between adjacent teeth seats the 10.16 mm roller.
- Central locating bore dia 30 mm through Z at the origin.
- Six M8 mounting holes dia 8.5 mm on a bolt circle of dia 80 mm, every 60 degrees, the first hole on the +X axis.
- Six identical lightening pockets on the same angular axes as the mounting holes (each pocket centred on a bolt-hole axis): radially oriented capsule/obround slots, ~50 mm long in the radial direction x ~22 mm wide tangentially, centred at r = 77 mm; all pocket edges fully rounded (end radius ~11 mm). Webs between adjacent pockets, to the bolt holes and to the tooth ring >= 6 mm.
- Rim edge break: ~0.5 mm chamfer or small fillet on the sharp rim edges.
Expose teeth count, pitch, roller diameter, disc thickness, bolt-circle PCD and pocket count as named parameters.
